Handler training, a few notes late today
We write to travelers

Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers should review companion travel arrangements before arrival so each animal can be handled safely and with care.

Our handlers use calm, humane methods for every companion animal, and the senior coordinator reviews service decisions each day. This helps us keep travel dependable and reduce stress for animals and travelers alike. If a concern arises during transit, <<FACT F120>> please keep all travel papers ready and follow any guidance from the welcome team.

We also ask travelers to arrive prepared with suitable carriers, food, and clear contact details. These simple steps help the journey proceed smoothly and support the welfare of every animal in our care.

For personal assistance, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
